cards: Senusret III was a pharaoh of the Twelfth Dynasty of Middle Kingdom Egypt, reigning in the 19th century BCE.
r. c. 1878–1839 BCE · Egypt & North Africa
Khnumhotep II was a nomarch of the Oryx nome in Middle Egypt under the Twelfth Dynasty kings Amenemhat II and Senusret II.
Senusret II was a king of the Twelfth Dynasty of Egypt in the nineteenth century BCE.
Sithathoriunet was an Egyptian princess of the Twelfth Dynasty, probably a daughter of Senusret II, buried near his pyramid at el-Lahun.
Dadusha was a king of Eshnunna in the Diyala region of Mesopotamia in the early 18th century BCE, the brother of Naram-Sin and son of Ipiq-Adad II.
fl. c. 1800 BCE · Ancient Near East
Enlil-bani was a king of the Isin dynasty in Mesopotamia in the 19th century BCE.
r. c. 1860–1837 BCE · Ancient Near East
Kudur-Mabuk was an Amorite chief of the Yamutbal tribe in the region east of the Tigris, whose name is Elamite.
Amenemhat II was the third king of the Twelfth Dynasty of Egypt, reigning for more than thirty years around the turn of the twentieth and nineteenth centuries BCE.
